title: Dual Song Spotlight
description: This week has two spotlights: Harry Styles' danceable electropop comeback single “Aperture” — a throbbing, romantic, slow-burn dance track with an intimately-delivered vocal — and Corneille's smooth, soulful cover of the Terence Trent D'Arby classic “Sign Your Name,” warm, lush and romantic. Each brings a different energy to the set.
songListNote: Dual Song of the Week: “Aperture” by Harry Styles and “Sign Your Name” by Corneille are both joining the request catalog this week.

features.description: Harry Styles' electropop/disco comeback single — intimate vocal, throbbing dance groove, signature romantic overtones. A strong current singalong feature.
features.songListNote: Dual Song of the Week — Harry Styles' danceable comeback single.

features.description: Corneille's smooth R&B cover of the soul classic — warm, romantic, lush and intimate.
